Tested locally, there are issues with the generated markup:

Before | After
-|-
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/20a12b94-eea3-4c5a-999f-88cd075109da) | ![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5bad116e-cb21-4578-a78a-5c5495a8b516)

Also, the file permissions were changed to `644` but we should keep using `755` so the script can be run directly. Use `chmod +x doc/tools/make_rst.py` for this. On Windows, use `git update-index --chmod=+x doc/tools/make_rst.py` instead.

For future reference, you can test this by running `doc/tools/make_rst.py doc/classes modules platform -o ../godot-docs/classes` then run `make html` in `godot-docs`, assuming you have a [godot-docs](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-docs) repository clone in the parent folder of the Godot repository clone.
